title: FilologiaSarda Sardinian
notes: Digital reproduction (PDF) of Gerolamo Araolla's 'Rimas diversas spirituales' (original collection 1597), the spiritual verse of a Sardinian priest of Sassari, edited by Maurizio Virdis (Cuec, series Scrittori sardi, 2006, 510 pp.). It is published on the portal of the Centro di Studi Filologici Sardi (Cagliari), which offers the series as PDF files beside the print edition. The record is one entry in an ongoing series of editions of Sardinian authors. Corpus statistics (text, word and language counts, period) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this edition, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it). https://www.filologiasarda.eu/.
license_note: No licence on the book page, the portal home page, the Credits page or the privacy notice; no copyright line or Creative Commons mark either (checked 2026-10-13). Only the journal Bollettino di Studi Sardi is stated to be open access (on UniCa Open Journals).
